conclusion_reason: s.30 para 4 requires the controller to act without delay and within thirty days of receiving the request, and s.30 para 2 limits refusal to refusal under law or court order with likely harm to others' rights and freedoms; the answer gives the deadline and quotes the refusal clause, though its summary splits it into two grounds.

problems.quote: ธนาคารจะปฏิเสธคำขอได้เฉพาะสองกรณี คือ (๑) เป็นการปฏิเสธตามกฎหมายหรือคำสั่งศาล และ (๒) การเข้าถึงและขอรับสำเนา
problems.why: s.30 para 2 joins the two elements with 'และ' in a single clause (refusal under law or court order AND access would likely harm others' rights and freedoms); presenting them as two separate cases widens the refusal ground beyond the literal text.
